children: Bitcoin rises as investors look to diversify their investments beyond the dollar ahead of the Treasury's long-dated bond buyback operation starting on Thursday. The Treasury is expected to announce the size of the buybacks on Wednesday. Markets also await U.S. inflation data due on Friday. Bitcoin rises 1.0% to last trade at $79,256. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
